# Contributing to CRAX

Thanks for your interest in contributing! We're building a minimal, React + Vite-powered SPA framework with just the right features.

## Getting Started

1. Fork the repo
2. Create a feature branch
3. Run `pnpm install` and `pnpm dev`
4. Open a PR with clear explanation

## Code Style

- TypeScript
- React 19
- Tailwind v4
- Keep it simple and composable, hook spiced and clean
- Use Functions unless you can't classes ain't needed most of the times. Like 99% of the time!

## Good First Issues

Check the [issues](https://github.com/craxjs/crax/issues) labeled `good first issue`.
